div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 95) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center; width: 520px;

span.p:
NORMALIZATION & FILTERING
• Name normalization — Inc / Ltd / Pvt / SARL
• Address normalization — Rd→Road, landmarks
• Missing values — 3.3% of addresses empty
• City / Country / Postcode normalization
• Unicode by CATEGORY, not word-class — protects Devanagari

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 95) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CANDIDATE GENERATION / BLOCKING
• Name similarity • Address similarity
• City / Postcode keys • TF-IDF / BM25
• Char n-gram + ANN
• Partition by COUNTRY first — 0 cross-country matches
Union of name-blocker AND address-blocker is REQUIRED:
14.8% of true pairs share NO name token

IMPORTANT — Ground truth NEVER deletes candidates.
It only answers was the true pair retrieved?
ALL generated candidate pairs remain available to the ML model.

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 95) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 520px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PAIRWISE FEATURE ENGINEERING
• Name similarity • Address similarity
• Jaccard • Levenshtein / edit similarity
• TF-IDF cosine • Char n-gram overlap
• City match • Postal-code match
• Phone similarity • Country match ← constant, drop
Computed for EVERY candidate pair, match or not

• Precision • Recall • F1
• COMPETITION METRIC: macro-averaged F0.5
F0.5 = 1.25·P·R ÷ 0.25·P + R
computed per S1 entity, then averaged; singletons included
